title: Training Day
summary: Learn to move, strike and use your special. Then show the thugs who's boss.

objectives.text: Use your special ability twice (see the controls)

dialogue.speaker: Dot
dialogue.text: Welcome to Brightport! I'm Dot, your dispatcher. Let's check the suit. Try running around.

dialogue.speaker: Dot
dialogue.text: Smooth! Now hop. The city has lots of puddles.

dialogue.speaker: Dot
dialogue.text: Great. Give the air a few good punches.

dialogue.speaker: Dot
dialogue.text: Nice combo. Your hero has a special move too: check the controls and try it out!

dialogue.speaker: Dot
dialogue.text: Uh-oh, three thugs just wandered in. They look grumpy. Handle it!

dialogue.speaker: Dot
dialogue.text: Training complete! Out in the city there are challenges for scrap and XP. Spend scrap at the upgrade bay.
